@Roth.exists_eq_pow_mul_of_rootMultiplicity : ∀ {R : Polynomial ℤ} {h : ℤ} {q : ℕ},
  0 < q →
    IsCoprime h ↑q →
      ∃ Q,
        R =
          (Polynomial.C ↑q * Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C h) ^
              Polynomial.rootMultiplicity (↑h / ↑q) (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) R) *
            Q

theorem Roth.exists_eq_pow_mul_of_rootMultiplicity : ∀ {R : Polynomial ℤ} {h : ℤ} {q : ℕ},
  0 < q →
    IsCoprime h ↑q →
      ∃ Q,
        R =
          (Polynomial.C ↑q * Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C h) ^
              Polynomial.rootMultiplicity (↑h / ↑q) (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) R) *
            Q :=
fun {R} {h} {q} hq hcop ↦
  let t := Polynomial.rootMultiplicity (↑h / ↑q) (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) R);
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrArg (fun _a ↦ ∃ Q, R = (Polynomial.C ↑q * Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C h) ^ _a * Q)
        (have this := rfl;
        this)))
    (have hq' :=
      cast (Eq.symm (Eq.trans (congrArg (Ne ↑q) (Eq.symm Nat.cast_zero)) (congrArg Not Nat.cast_inj._simp_1)))
        (LT.lt.ne' hq);
    have hmap :=
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a = Polynomial.C ↑q * (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (↑h / ↑q)))
            (Polynomial.map_sub (Int.castRingHom ℚ))))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a ↦
                _a - Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) (Polynomial.C h) =
                  Polynomial.C ↑q * (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (↑h / ↑q)))
              (Polynomial.map_mul (Int.castRingHom ℚ))))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg
                (fun _a ↦
                  _a * Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) Polynomial.X -
                      Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) (Polynomial.C h) =
                    Polynomial.C ↑q * (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (↑h / ↑q)))
                (Polynomial.map_C (Int.castRingHom ℚ))))
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a ↦
                    Polynomial.C ((Int.castRingHom ℚ) ↑q) * _a - Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) (Polynomial.C h) =
                      Polynomial.C ↑q * (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (↑h / ↑q)))
                  (Polynomial.map_X (Int.castRingHom ℚ))))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg
                    (fun _a ↦
                      Polynomial.C ((Int.castRingHom ℚ) ↑q) * Polynomial.X - _a =
                        Polynomial.C ↑q * (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (↑h / ↑q)))
                    (Polynomial.map_C (Int.castRingHom ℚ))))
                (Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg
                      (fun _a ↦
                        Polynomial.C ((Int.castRingHom ℚ) ↑q) * Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C ((Int.castRingHom ℚ) h) =
                          _a)
                      (mul_sub (Polynomial.C ↑q) Polynomial.X (Polynomial.C (↑h / ↑q)))))
                  (Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg
                        (fun _a ↦
                          Polynomial.C ((Int.castRingHom ℚ) ↑q) * Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C ((Int.castRingHom ℚ) h) =
                            Polynomial.C ↑q * Polynomial.X - _a)
                        (Eq.symm Polynomial.C_mul)))
                    (Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg
                          (fun _a ↦
                            Polynomial.C ((Int.castRingHom ℚ) ↑q) * Polynomial.X -
                                Polynomial.C ((Int.castRingHom ℚ) h) =
                              Polynomial.C ↑q * Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C _a)
                          (mul_div_cancel₀ (↑h) hq')))
                      (of_eq_true
                        (Eq.trans
                          (congr
                            (congrArg Eq
                              (congr
                                (congrArg HSub.hSub
                                  (congrFun'
                                    (congrArg HMul.hMul
                                      (Eq.trans (congrArg (⇑Polynomial.C) (map_natCast (Int.castRingHom ℚ) q))
                                        (map_natCast Polynomial.C q)))
                                    Polynomial.X))
                                (Eq.trans (congrArg (⇑Polynomial.C) (eq_intCast (Int.castRingHom ℚ) h))
                                  (map_intCast Polynomial.C h))))
                            (congr
                              (congrArg HSub.hSub
                                (congrFun' (congrArg HMul.hMul (map_natCast Polynomial.C q)) Polynomial.X))
                              (map_intCast Polynomial.C h)))
                          (eq_self (↑q * Polynomial.X - ↑h)))))))))));
    (Polynomial.IsPrimitive.Int.dvd_iff_map_cast_dvd_map_cast ((Polynomial.C ↑q * Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C h) ^ t) R
          (Roth.isPrimitive_pow✝ (Roth.isPrimitive_linear✝ hcop) t)).mpr
      (Eq.mpr
        (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a ∣ Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) R) (Polynomial.map_pow (Int.castRingHom ℚ) t)))
        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a ^ t ∣ Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) R) hmap))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a ∣ Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) R)
                (mul_pow (Polynomial.C ↑q) (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (↑h / ↑q)) t)))
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a ↦ _a * (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (↑h / ↑q)) ^ t ∣ Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) R)
                  (Eq.symm Polynomial.C_pow)))
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a) (propext (Polynomial.C_mul_dvd (pow_ne_zero t hq')))))
                (Polynomial.pow_rootMultiplicity_dvd (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) R) (↑h / ↑q))))))))

ROOTFACTOR196_FULL_TYPE: ∀ {R : Polynomial ℤ} {h : ℤ} {q : ℕ},
  0 < q →
    IsCoprime h ↑q →
      ∃ (Q : Polynomial ℤ),
        R =
          (Polynomial.C ↑q * Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C h) ^
              Polynomial.rootMultiplicity (↑h / ↑q) (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) R) *
            Q

Polynomial.IsPrimitive.Int.dvd_iff_map_cast_dvd_map_cast : ∀ (p q : Polynomial ℤ),
  p.IsPrimitive → (p ∣ q ↔ Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) p ∣ Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) q)

@Polynomial.pow_rootMultiplicity_dvd : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Ring R] (p : Polynomial R) (a : R),
  (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) ^ Polynomial.rootMultiplicity a p ∣ p

@Polynomial.C_mul_dvd : ∀ {R : Type u_1} {a : R} [inst : Field R] {p q : Polynomial R},
  a ≠ 0 → (Polynomial.C a * p ∣ q ↔ p ∣ q)

@Polynomial.IsPrimitive.mul : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [NormalizedGCDMonoid R] {p q : Polynomial R},
  p.IsPrimitive → q.IsPrimitive → (p * q).IsPrimitive
@isCoprime_zero_right : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] {x : R}, IsCoprime x 0 ↔ IsUnit x

@generic : ∀ {A : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsGCDMonoid A] [inst_3 : Field K]
  [inst_4 : Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K] {R : A[X]} {h q : A},
  IsRelPrime h q →
